thread:
pete-docs: FYI I opened a micro-guide PR: export manifest format, HMAC integrity, TTL-override workflow, and short SDK snippets (Rust/Java/curl). Link: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/6488

anya-security: Thanks. A couple of policy asks up front: (1) avoid phrasing like 'we keep' or 'indefinitely' in SOC2-facing text, (2) call out that exported artifacts are access-controlled, logged, and integrity-checked.

pete-docs: Draft line: 'Audit logs are retained for 90 days by default; export retention is controlled at the manifest level and may be extended as required by law or contractual obligations.' Thoughts?

anya-security: That wording works. Add a sentence that exported manifests include an HMAC-SHA256 checksum and that access is gated by RBAC and audited. Also include legal-hold contact.

olive-legal: Legal prefers the phrase 'as required by law or contractual obligations' and asks we add legal@redwood.com for hold requests. Also note that example identifiers in docs are pseudonymized.

mila-eng: Added two tiny SDK snippets for the PR. Rust sampling example (reproducible via seed):
```rust
use redwood_audit::Client;
let c = Client::new(std::env::var("REDWOOD_KEY").unwrap());
let resp = c.query_events(&Query { sample: Some(0.01), start: "2025-07-01".into(), end: "2025-07-31".into(), seed: Some(42) }).await?;
println!("total={}", resp.total);
```

mila-eng: Java export creation example (manifest request):
```java
AuditClient client = new AuditClient(System.getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"));
Map<String,Object> body = Map.of("start","2025-07-01","end","2025-07-31","mode","full");
Map<String,Object> resp = client.createExport(body);
System.out.println(resp.get("manifest_id"));
```

pete-docs: Nice. Also added a one-liner curl that shows pagination and seed for reproducible sampling:
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/query \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"sample":0.01,"start":"2025-07-01","end":"2025-07-31","seed":42,"page":1}'
```

anya-security: Good to include seed note. Please also add a short callout: "Sampling is intended for operational triage; it can under-represent rare anomalies. For formal investigations, request a full export (manifest mode: 'full')." Link to monitoring playbook.

pete-docs: Added the sampling-bias callout and playbook link. Also included a tiny manifest example showing HMAC field (illustrative only):
```
manifest_id: m-12345
file_count: 3
hmac: hmac-sha256:9f2a...
retention_ttl: 365d  # manifest-level TTL
```

olive-legal: LGTM with one tiny wording tweak: replace 'may be extended' with 'may be extended as required by law or contractual obligations' where it appears. I'll mark legal approved after that change.

pete-docs: Done. Final checklist: swap wording per legal, include legal@redwood.com, add pseudonymized example IDs, ensure Rust/Java/curl snippets present, add HMAC + TTL manifest note, link to TTL-override workflow (internal). Will merge after security + legal ack and CI linkcheck. @bot-ci please run linkcheck and add 'security-reviewed' label on merge.
